evidence.summary: Learning objective and scope: Collects the payoff of the architecture: the full rules regression matrix runs with no window open, and the matrix must cover all eight lines rather than one sampled row.

find_winner can be tested on a plain list of strings with no Tkinter window. -- confirmed -- imported tic_tac_toe and ran the full matrix with no tk.Tk() ever instantiated; notebook 17-28 does the same in Pyodide, where Tkinter is unavailable at all, the strongest possible demonstration.

The stated nine-row test matrix is achievable and correct. -- confirmed -- all nine rows verified against the real implementation; the project harness runs 33 assertions covering the same ground and all pass.

A test covering only one row would not catch a typo in a diagonal. -- confirmed and demonstrated concretely -- injecting Debug Lab 9's (0,4,6) typo leaves a single-row test green, while this lesson's full matrix catches it via the last-move-wins case. As found, the grader for 17-16 was the one test that did NOT catch it (F-009), now fixed.
